Why did Krishna marry sixteen thousand princesses? Remember Narakasura, the demon who locked away sixteen thousand princesses? As the story goes, when Satyabhama defeated him, the princesses were finally free.
But they had nowhere to go. Their kingdoms would not take them back. People whispered, they were prisoners for years. Who will accept them now?
Wait, what did Krishna do? He said, I will. He married every one of them, gave each a palace, and gave them his own name. So no one could ever whisper again.
That's why Krishna has sixteen thousand wives. Not for himself, but for their honor. Comment Dwarkadhish if this changed how you see him.
